property_summary: For any timestamps t1 < t2 and any actor, two consecutive valid fallback calls (each exactly 10 ether, timestamps strictly increasing) must both succeed, since pastBlockTime is only advanced after the checks; the mutant writes pastBlockTime before the checks, so the second call always reverts (its own timestamp equals the freshly-written pastBlockTime).
change_summary: Move the pastBlockTime assignment before the two require checks so pastBlockTime is updated even when a require reverts.
